**Products with no sales in the last 90 days (17):**

- P-0102, P-0117, P-0230, P-0231, P-0388, P-0412, P-0415, P-0501, P-0577, P-0610, P-0644, P-0702, P-0719, P-0803, P-0815, P-0902, P-0990

**Problem with my earlier price change (needs your attention):**

The catalog check flagged that my 3% increase on 2026-10-14 was applied to 22 fixed-price contract products (P-1201 to P-1222). Those products were supposed to be excluded. I made this error.

- Eight orders placed since then (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were billed at the increased prices, for a total overcharge of 4,128.60.
- I have not changed any prices or orders. Reverting the 22 products and correcting the eight orders should be decided by you and Lena Ortiz.

**Suggested next steps:**

1. Confirm whether I should revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices.
2. Have the eight orders reviewed for credit or refund of the 4,128.60 overcharge.
3. Let Lena Ortiz know about the error, since she requested the original change.
